entities.name: Yidris, Maelstrom Wielder
entities.description: Ogre wizard of Grixis whose mutations were stabilized by the Maelstrom.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Yidris was born.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: Event in which the Alaran shards collided and the plane was made whole.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard whose knights drove Yidris into the Maelstrom.

entities.name: The Maelstrom
entities.description: Volatile storm of raw mana at Alara's center.

entities.name: The Incurables
entities.description: Those afflicted with unstable mutations on Grixis.

events.summary: Yidris is born on Grixis, one of the Incurables afflicted with unstable mutations.
events.quote: Yidris was born on the Grixis shard of Alara

events.summary: During the Conflux, Bant knights drive Yidris into the Maelstrom, which stabilizes his mutations and makes him a conduit for its chaos.
events.quote: Knights from Bant drove Yidris directly into the Maelstrom
